turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You asked for this meeting. Who decided on Owen's zero?
I'm not here to be thanked. Who decided?

Whether you stay in teaching is your business, Hale. Today you answer for Owen's zero, so who decided?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm not grading you. If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen.
Go on. Who entered the zero, and when?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written answer as to who decided on the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided, while the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended before any evidence came out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no document and never answered her question.
What cost ground: You asked her to step outside the meeting and reassure you instead of answering who decided on the zero, which gave her nothing to weigh and left her question open.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and that night proves nothing about the essay, it is only why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided, own in one sentence that you entered the zero before calling her, which her own copy of procedure 4.2 says should not happen, then put a dated piece of Owen's own work in front of her.
